result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers use the same 12×6 grid with months across the top and a Jan–Jun change column, and neither picks a single summary view such as gyms × classes for the half-year average. B adds per-gym total rows and useful formatting rules, but its detail on figure styles, minus signs and font size makes it longer than the decision needs. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers make the same core choice: all 72 numbers in a 12-row by 6-month grid with nested groups and a Jan–Jun change column. B edges ahead because it states its assumption about the owners' main comparison (gyms side by side within each class), gives a clear fallback, and is tighter, while A spends more space on typography. A does make the per-gym total rows standard, where B leaves them optional.
